description:
Accounting preparation for meshmakers GmbH — connect bank transactions with
accounting documents and analyze costs by category.

Installs:
- the Meshmakers.Accounting construction kit model (auto-imported from the
  catalog, pulls Basic + Basic.Accounting transitively)
- fiscal-year 2026 with 15 expense categories and 3 income categories
  (CategoryKind EXPENSE/INCOME, AB#4507; Förderungen/GRANTS since AB#5388,
  Zinsaufwand/INTERESTEXPENSE since AB#5389)
- the Documents root folder (System.Files/FolderRoot, documents/receipts storage)
- the FinAPI adapter (octo-finapi-adapter Helm chart, linked to the Release
  adapter repository; the finAPI credentials live on the FinApiConfiguration
  entity below, not on the adapter)
- 41 pipelines. The six finAPI pipelines (account/transaction sync,
  bank-connection refresh, BIC resolution, web-form create/complete) share
  ONE "FinAPI" DataFlow so they
  deploy together and appear as tabs in one execution-history dialog. There
  is no direct bank-connection import any more: PSD2/SCA goes through the
  web-form pair createWebFormImport -> completeWebFormImport. The rest sit in
  their own DataFlows, among them: Excel tree import, CSV transaction import,
  AI prompt, document upload (staging + duplicate check only), asynchronous
  document analysis (5-minute polling + on-demand via POST /processDocuments:
  OCR + AI extraction of staged uploads, replaces the former synchronous
  analysis and the Todo fallback — incomplete extractions stay visible on the
  UploadedDocument inbox entity), transaction matching, document page editing
  (/editDocument — it also does the multi-page merge that the removed
  /mergeDocuments route used to do, AB#4760)
- every HTTP route of those pipelines is authenticated and role-gated
  (FromHttpRequest@2, allowAnonymous:false + requiredRoles, AB#4685):
  AccountingManagement for the money-moving and bulk/export/import routes,
  AccountingManagement+AccountingEmployee for the inbox/document/ToDo
  routes. AccountingShareholder reaches none of them
- the Assign Fiscal Years pipeline (AB#5624, Transaction Maintenance DataFlow):
  keeps every bank transaction assigned to the fiscal year of its BookingDate
  (TransactionToFiscalYear) - a full, idempotent reconcile every 15 minutes plus
  the management route POST /assignFiscalYears ({"dryRun": true} plans only).
  The first run after the update is the backfill
- the Document Retention DataFlow (AB#5780, KARL+ K-01 pilot): the Stamp Document
  Retention reconcile keeps AccountingDocument.RetentionUntil = 31.12. of the
  document-date year + RetentionSettings.RetentionDefaultYears (seeded 7, minimum 7;
  22 years for documents flagged RetentionLongTerm) on every document - every 15 minutes
  plus the management route POST /stampRetention ({"dryRun": true} plans only); it only
  ever raises a stamp, and the first run after the update is the backfill. Plus POST
  /verifyDocumentHash, which re-hashes a document's stored original against its intake
  SHA-256 (FileHash) and logs every check (OriginalVerification). Under the lock the Edit
  Document pipeline replaces instead of deleting (superseded documents stay CANCELLED).
  Needs a DeployDataFlow after the update
- the camt.053 Export DataFlow (AB#6224, POST /exportCamt053, management-only):
  camt.053.001.02 statements per bank account and calendar month for the tax
  advisor's BMD, balances computed backwards from BankAccount.Balance /
  BalanceDate, plausibility gates in the response and the protocol. The BMD
  handover ZIP carries the same statements under camt/ and a section 5 in
  pruefprotokoll.txt; the finAPI account sync now stamps BalanceDate
- the /listMailFolders route (AB#5370, management-only) in the Document Ingest
  DataFlow: lists an IMAP or Microsoft 365 mailbox's folders in exactly the
  syntax the corresponding mail trigger accepts, for the folder picker on the
  two mail cards of Settings -> Import. Reads the same three configuration
  entities the trigger pipelines use (Uses edges); never writes to a mailbox
- the /listFailedImportMails and /requeueFailedImportMails routes (AB#7087, management-only)
  in the Document Ingest DataFlow: list the mails the e-mail import gave up on (the channel's
  failed folder) and send them back into the import folder - Microsoft 365 and IMAP. The node
  clears the OctoMesh-Import-* markers FIRST and moves the mail only if that worked (a mail
  moved back with its markers on is parked again by the next poll, AB#7068). Mailbox, folders
  and credentials come only from the same configuration entities the triggers use (Uses
  edges), never from the request. Every re-queued mail is audited as a
  Meshmakers.Accounting/FailedMailRequeue entity (who, when, channel, mailbox, mail, outcome).
  Needs the Mesh adapter with the ListFailedImportMails@1 / RequeueFailedImportMails@1 nodes
  (octo-mesh-adapter, AB#7087) and a DeployDataFlow of Document Ingest after the update
- the Microsoft 365 e-mail document import pipeline — ships DISABLED
  (System/Enabled=false); the meshmakers-app activates it from Settings ->
  Document import (writes the EmailImportSettings configuration, flips
  System/Enabled and deploys the DataFlow). Since AB#5345 the app NEVER
  rewrites a PipelineDefinition: the definition is release content that a
  re-apply reinstates, so every setting written into it was lost on the next
  apply and each save produced a new version of the pipeline entity
- the MicrosoftGraphDocuments configuration (placeholder Azure app-registration
  credentials) used by the e-mail import via the Uses association
- the _trees repo-browser query
- the InvoiceCheckSettings configuration (AB#5773/AB#5772): thresholds of the
  § 11 UStG mandatory-field check of incoming invoices (400 / 10,000 EUR) and
  whether a missing field parks the upload in the Inbox, plus the EU VIES
  VAT id verification switch and cache lifetime (AB#5772 - outbound HTTPS to
  ec.europa.eu from the Mesh adapter, answers cached as VatIdVerification
  entities) (isRuntimeState - edit it in Refinery Studio, a re-apply keeps the
  tenant's values)
- the VatReturnSettings configuration (AB#7512, Feature AB#7507 VAT estimate): taxation basis
  AGREEDCONSIDERATION (Soll - a document belongs to the period of its invoice / service date)
  and return interval MONTHLY, as agreed with the tax advisor (isRuntimeState - a tenant's own
  value survives a re-apply). New AccountingDocument fields for the VAT treatment (VatTreatment,
  VatTreatmentSource, VatTreatmentReason, ReverseChargeRate) and the facts that decide it,
  which the Document Analysis and AI prompt extraction now keep: VendorCountryCode (also when
  the postal address is incomplete: AI country, else the VAT id prefix, never a partial Address
  record), ReverseChargeNote and TaxExemptionNote (printed text). The extraction prompt no
  longer lets airline/travel "taxes, fees and charges" become the tax amount of a rate row and
  never gives a 0 % row a tax amount. Needs a DeployDataFlow of Document Analysis and AI Prompt after
  the update, and ClearCache per tenant after the CK upgrade (AB#7489)
- the VAT treatment derivation (AB#7513, blueprint 3.9.0): the "Derive VAT Treatment" pipeline in
  the Document Analysis DataFlow is the ONE rule engine (first match wins, every result carries a
  reason). Document Analysis asks it for every document it creates and writes VatTreatment,
  VatTreatmentSource (DERIVED) and VatTreatmentReason; a document the rules cannot decide keeps an
  empty VatTreatment and a reason = "to check" (never an implicit domestic). The management route
  POST /deriveVatTreatment (AccountingManagement) re-derives EXISTING documents with the same
  script: { "from", "to" (document day), "dryRun" } - dryRun defaults to TRUE and reports old/new
  treatment, reason and the counts per treatment and rule; only { "dryRun": false } writes, and
  only VatTreatment, VatTreatmentSource and VatTreatmentReason. A VatTreatmentSource MANUAL
  document is never touched. Documents created through the AI Prompt chat route are not derived at
  creation (that DataFlow cannot reach the pipeline); they stay "to check" until the route runs.
  Needs a DeployDataFlow of Document Analysis after the update (the pipeline is new)
- EU acquisition of goods (AB#7550, blueprint 3.10.0, CK 3.11.0): the new VatTreatment value
  EUACQUISITIONGOODS is told apart from the EU service reverse charge by the derive rule - goods
  wording in the printed note gives EUACQUISITIONGOODS (RC_EU_GOODS / OUT_EU_GOODS), service wording
  or no wording stays EUREVERSECHARGE, goods AND service wording is "to check" (RC_EU_KIND_UNCLEAR /
  OUT_EU_KIND_UNCLEAR). The update changes NO existing document; EXISTING documents are reclassified
  only by POST /deriveVatTreatment (dry run first, then an explicit { "dryRun": false }). Needs a
  DeployDataFlow of Document Analysis after the update (the rule engine changed) and ClearCache per
  tenant after the CK upgrade (AB#7489)
- bank connection sync status with its reason (AB#7617, blueprint 3.11.0, Basic.Accounting 1.11.0):
  the sync-transactions pipeline stamps SyncStatusReason / SyncStatusInterface / SyncStatusDetail next
  to SyncStatus, and ActionRequired now means a human has to act (a web form left behind by a
  background update does not count while bookings are fresh); the bank-connection refresh records
  LastSyncAttemptAt / LastSyncAttemptResult. Its six-hour schedule (67c9a1f0b2e4d8c3a1f00062) ships
  DISABLED: on the Meshmakers mandator every background update ends in WEB_FORM_REQUIRED. Needs the
  finAPI adapter release that carries AB#7617 and a DeployDataFlow of FinAPI after the update;
  ClearCache per tenant after the CK upgrade (AB#7489). An existing tenant keeps its own
  System/Enabled of the trigger (disable it there, see the story)
- handover package: documents paid in the period (AB#7709, blueprint 3.12.0, no CK change): the PDF
  of every document linked to a payment BOOKED in the requested period ships in the package of
  the payment month, whatever its DocumentDate or fiscal year - a document dated outside the
  period (or without a date) lies in {fiscal year}/{payment month}/Belege anderer Perioden/{type}/,
  belege.csv gains the last column Grund ("Zahlung in der Periode"), zahlungen.csv the last column
  Datei (the ZIP path(s) of the linked documents, '|'-separated) and the protocol section 3a ends
  each row with "liegt bei: <ZIP path>". Needs a DeployDataFlow of BMD Handover Export after the update
- handover package: contracts (AB#7710, blueprint 3.13.0, no CK change): a recurring document
  (Dauerbeleg) linked to a payment booked in the period ships in EVERY package that has such a
  payment, in {fiscal year}/{payment month}/Verträge/, whatever its own date; belege.csv Grund =
  "Zahlung in der Periode (Dauerbeleg)". A contract without a payment in the period keeps the old
  rule. The protocol header says so. Needs a DeployDataFlow of BMD Handover Export after the update
- handover package: "Bitte prüfen" for amount differences (AB#7713, blueprint 3.14.0, no CK change):
  protocol section 1b is now "ZAHLUNG UND BELEGE STIMMEN NICHT ÜBEREIN - BITTE PRÜFEN" and lists EVERY
  difference of 0.01 or more between a payment and its documents, in both directions and also for
  automatic matches (the 15 EUR / 2 % cut is gone; the matcher's 15 EUR tolerance is unchanged, the
  difference only becomes visible), with payment, documents, difference, direction and the known
  reason (transfer-fee tolerance, Skonto, card fee, foreign currency). A PAID document with two
  payments that do not add up to it is listed on the document side. A Dauerbeleg is compared with
  its amount per period, a foreign-currency document with its EUR amount; without them they are
  counted in the header. Needs a DeployDataFlow of BMD Handover Export after the update
- handover package: known reasons in section 1b (AB#7797, blueprint 3.15.0, no CK change): a card
  debit whose surplus over the documents is the foreign-transaction fee 1,10 + 0,75 % of the document
  amount (+-0,03, "Auslandseinsatzentgelt") and one debit equal to 2..12 periods of a single Dauerbeleg
  ("mehrere Perioden") are no longer listed but counted in a header line; the document side sums the
  two payments with their sign, so a refund nets a payment. Needs a DeployDataFlow of BMD Handover
  Export after the update
- handover package: section 1b nets the documents of a payment (AB#7878, blueprint 3.15.1, no CK
  change): a credit note (negative gross) counts against the invoices settled with the same payment
  (3600 - 3000 = 600 for one payment of 600) and a CANCELLED duplicate sharing the payment is left
  out, so neither is listed as a difference any more. Needs a DeployDataFlow of BMD Handover Export
  after the update
- matcher links only with identity evidence (AB#7898, blueprint 3.15.2, no CK change): every pass
  of the Match Transactions pipeline that creates a TransactionToDocument link (exact amount, tip,
  amount+date fallback, both foreign-currency passes, group assignment, multi-invoice upload, AI
  post-check) needs NAME (a shared party word, OCR- and abbreviation-tolerant), NUMBER (the document
  number in the purpose) or ALIAS (the merchant token / counterpart was linked to the same party
  before by a manual or evidence-backed link); the account-holder, document-number and series passes
  carry that evidence by their query. A pair without evidence stays a suggestion in Bank > Abgleich.
  Every linking writer names pass and evidence in the MatchComment. The card merchant parser knows
  the card number D and the terminal layout "MERCHANT 3145 K2 30.01. 12:17". Existing links are not
  re-examined. Needs a DeployDataFlow of Match Transactions after the update
- PayPal/card settlement rows name their twin in the handover (AB#7714, blueprint 3.15.3, no CK
  change): in zahlungen.csv a transaction Ignored with ExclusionReason SETTLEMENTDUPLICATE reads Status
  "Verrechnung (kein eigener Beleg)" and the new trailing column Hinweis names the Matched twin the
  matcher's settlement pass paired it with (same rule, derived at export time: same signed amount,
  +-7 days, PayPal marker, different own account) - date, counterpart, amount, account, document
  number and the file in the package; the twin's document PDF ships in the package also when the
  twin is booked in another month. No or more than one twin: "Gegenbuchung nicht eindeutig gefunden
  - bitte prüfen" and protocol section 1c. Existing columns keep their order. Needs a DeployDataFlow
  of BMD Handover Export after the update
- open points with due date and "question to the tax advisor" (AB#7715, blueprint 3.16.0, CK 3.12.0):
  the Todo type gains the optional DueDate (the day at 00:00 UTC) and ForTaxAdvisor (Boolean); the app
  writes both from the ToDo dialogs and the "Offenen Punkt anlegen" action of the Handover page. No
  seed or pipeline change; existing ToDos keep working without the fields. ClearCache per tenant after
  the CK upgrade (AB#7489)
- open points in the handover package (AB#7716, blueprint 3.16.1, seed only): BMD Handover Export ships
  offene-punkte.csv (Art; Frage/Punkt; Datum; Gegenpartei; Betrag; Belegnummer; Datei; Verantwortlich;
  Fällig; Status) and pruefprotokoll.txt section 6 "FRAGEN AN DIE STEUERBERATUNG / OFFENE PUNKTE" (questions
  to the tax advisor / our open points): OPEN and INPROGRESS ToDos linked to a payment or document of the
  period, unlinked ToDos marked ForTaxAdvisor, and payments of the period in clarification. Every finding of
  sections 1-4 with an open ToDo names its owner and due date; the result line counts the findings without
  an owner. Needs a DeployDataFlow of BMD Handover Export after the update
- credit notes (AB#7717, blueprint 3.17.0, CK 3.13.0): AccountingDocument gains the optional IsCreditNote
  (Boolean) and the association CreditNoteForDocument (credit note -> original invoice). Match Transactions
  to Documents never links a credit note automatically (every candidate query filters IsCreditNote NotEquals
  true; the reconciliation workspace proposes it only for a refund of the same party). BMD Handover Export
  marks it "Gutschrift" on the cover sheet (subtitle and row "Belegtyp" with the original's number) and in
  belege.csv (new last columns Belegart and Originalbeleg), and lists credit notes of the period with neither
  an original invoice nor a refund payment in pruefprotokoll.txt section 2b "GUTSCHRIFTEN OHNE GEGENBELEG".
  Needs a DeployDataFlow of BMD Handover Export and of Match Transactions to Documents after the update;
  ClearCache per tenant after the CK upgrade (AB#7489)
NOT the app and NOT its OIDC client (AB#5210): both belong to the APP HOST,
seeded by MeshmakersAccounting.Host on the root tenant. A leaf cannot know the
public hostname, so seeding either here produced dead per-tenant URIs that a
re-apply kept restoring. The client reaches this tenant by mirroring from the
root instead.
- the AnthropicAiConfig AiConfiguration (placeholder API key) referenced by
  the AI pipelines via apiKeyConfigurationName. Its McpServerUrl is derived
  from the cluster (${octo.scheme}://mcp.${octo.domain}, AB#5646) and only
  seeded where the tenant has no value yet — a tenant override always wins
- the FinApiConfiguration (placeholder credentials, live.finapi.io) that all
  finAPI pipelines load via GetPipelineConfigByWellKnownName + Uses association

PREREQUISITES: communication must be enabled on the target tenant (Reporting is
NOT needed since 3.0.0 - the file system is the service-managed System.Files
model). The service-managed System.Communication blueprint seeds the Pool
(670000000000000000000001) and Mesh Adapter (670000000000000000000002)
this seed associates to.

Post-install:
- MANDATORY (every install and every update to >= 2.6.0, AB#6478): grant the
  AccountingManagement role to the pipeline service account of EACH adapter
  whose pipelines read categorization rules (the Mesh adapter 670000000000000000000002
  runs the transaction-matching pipeline). A blueprint cannot grant roles to
  clients; without it the Enforce lock policy aa..0345 (Read for
  AccountingManagement only) makes the pipeline read 0 rules and silently
  categorize nothing, while the pipeline still reports success:
    octo-cli -c GetAdapters                  (adapter rtId)
    octo-cli -c AddClientToRole -id octo-pipeline-sa-<adapterRtId> -r AccountingManagement
  Verify: wait 60 s (policy cache), run the matching pipeline and check that
  the step "Load enabled categorization rules" returns > 0 rules and new
  transactions get "(auto)" categories (CLAUDE.md, "Pipeline service account")
- DeployDataFlow per DataFlow. The app workload is NOT part of this blueprint
  any more — it lives on the app host (MeshmakersAccounting.Host)
- Set the real Anthropic API key on the AnthropicAiConfig configuration and
  the finAPI credentials on FinApiConfiguration — ONCE. Credential attributes
  carry isRuntimeState: true in the System.Communication model (ApiKey,
  ClientSecret, Password, Username, ClientId, AzureTenantId), so a blueprint
  re-apply PRESERVES them. scripts/om_set_secrets.ps1 sets them initially
  from the gitignored scripts/secrets.local.json
- The two ToDo-notification pipelines (Notify ToDo / Notify ToDo Inbound)
  ship DISABLED and take their mailbox from EmailImportSettings (AB#4934 —
  the mailbox is tenant-specific; earlier seeds hardcoded the meshmakers
  mailbox, so every tenant polled a foreign mailbox). Set the mailbox in
  MicrosoftGraphDocuments, fill EmailImportSettings (Settings -> Import),
  then enable + DeployDataFlow. Since AB#5216 the ToDo Inbound trigger reads
  its mailbox from EmailImportSettings via settingsConfiguration instead of
  the pipeline definition, so a re-apply no longer loses it — only
  System/Enabled falls back to false and has to be re-enabled.
- The Microsoft 365 e-mail import ships disabled — activate it in the
  meshmakers-app under Settings -> E-Mail Import after filling the Azure
  app-registration secrets on MicrosoftGraphDocuments via
  scripts/om_set_secrets.ps1 (microsoftGraph section). These survive a
  blueprint re-apply (isRuntimeState, same as Anthropic/finAPI).
- The IMAP e-mail import ships disabled too. Its connection (host, port,
  credentials, default folder) stays on the EmailAccountingAssistant receiver
  configuration; since AB#5345 its RUNTIME settings — poll interval, only
  unread, post-processing mode, folders, batch cap, filters — live on the
  seeded ImapImportSettings configuration (aa0…332, same CK type as
  EmailImportSettings, one instance per channel) and are edited under
  Settings -> Document import. Every one of them is optional: unset means the
  value in the pipeline definition applies, so a tenant upgrading into this
  keeps running exactly as before until somebody sets something.
- The remaining optional Teams/Signal import pipeline TEMPLATES still live in
  the repo's data/ folder — they carry tenant-specific secrets and are
  imported manually
